title: Property Consultant
description:
**Company Description**

RED | Real Estate Domain (KW RED) is the first market center to partner with KW Egypt, operating as a respected real estate brokerage known for integrity, professionalism, and client-focused service. The company has built a strong industry reputation by prioritizing transparent transactions and long-term relationships. A dedicated team of experts supports clients in achieving their real estate goals through data-driven decisions and innovative technology. By adapting to changing market dynamics, RED consistently delivers exceptional results and seamless real estate experiences. The company positions itself as a trusted partner for clients across all their real estate endeavors.

**Role Description**

The Property Consultant is a full-time, on-site role based in Cairo, Egypt. This position focuses on guiding clients through the property buying, selling, and leasing process, including conducting property viewings, preparing and presenting offers, and supporting negotiations. Day-to-day responsibilities include maintaining a portfolio of listings, researching market trends, and providing informed recommendations to help clients make data-driven decisions. The Property Consultant will handle client inquiries, build and maintain strong relationships, and ensure a professional and seamless experience from initial contact through closing. The role also involves collaborating with internal teams, using real estate technology tools, and meeting agreed sales and performance targets.

**Qualifications**

* Strong consulting skills to assess client needs, provide tailored property advice, and support data-driven decision-making.
* Excellent communication abilities for clear presentations, negotiations, and relationship-building with clients and colleagues.
* Proven customer service capabilities to ensure a responsive, professional, and client-centric real estate experience.
* Sales experience, including lead generation, pipeline management, and closing transactions in a competitive market.
* Foundational real estate knowledge of local market trends, property valuation, legal processes, and documentation.
* Ability to work on-site in Cairo, Egypt, with strong time management, organization, and attention to detail.
* Comfort with using real estate CRM systems and digital tools to track leads, properties, and client interactions.
* Relevant academic background or professional certifications in real estate, business, or a related field are advantageous.
* Fluency in English and Arabic, both written and spoken, is highly beneficial.
